## [20.6.0] - 2026-11-05 - "Film, Ad Research and Publishing"

Add film, ad-library research and Time Machine recovery workflows; refresh HyperFrames, Postel and React dependencies.

### New skills

- Add Time Machine recovery guidance for macOS backup discovery and restoration.
- Add MiniCut Film Studio with a pinned skill revision, retained MIT notice and explicit installation and paid-generation boundaries.
- Add LurkAPI ad research across Meta, Google, LinkedIn and TikTok libraries, with credit budgets and limits on inferred performance.

### Improvements

- Refresh seven HyperFrames skills to upstream v0.9.15, including CLI scaffolding, billing, media credentials and project credit limits while retaining AAS safeguards.
- Render Stageshow catalog demos without iframes and align the historical release archive with GitHub.
- Update Postel for Bluesky and Mastodon drafts, approved media URLs and LinkedIn first comments; retain X/LinkedIn generation limits.
- Clarify NetAPI's own IP sensor feed, 48-hour IP listing window and IPv4 coverage.

### Security and distribution

- Improve defensive Bash cleanup guidance and preserve interactive directory deletion after normalized path checks.
- Align React and React DOM at 19.3.1 in the catalog app and Loki frontend example; update Stageshow's optional Portless launcher to 0.15.8.

### Contributors

- @lliu56 for MiniCut ([#2283](https://github.com/sickn33/agentic-awesome-skills/pull/2283), original [#2273](https://github.com/sickn33/agentic-awesome-skills/pull/2273)).

# Agentic Awesome Skills — AI Skills & AAS Core

> **Find reusable instructions for your project, inspect their complete files, and keep an exact skill set you can review and reuse.**

Agentic Awesome Skills is a library of 2,926+ installable `SKILL.md` playbooks for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI and other AI coding agents. AAS Core helps Codex or Claude search the complete local catalog, record the skills the agent chooses, and preview a plan you can inspect before changing a target. Core does not rank or recommend skills.

**Start here:** [Explore the skill catalog](https://aaskills.tech/core/) · [Codex setup](https://aaskills.tech/docs/codex-cli-skills/) · [Claude Code setup](https://aaskills.tech/docs/claude-code-skills/) · [Install skills directly](#installation)

**Current release: V20.6.0.** AAS Core supports local catalog inspection, agent-owned selection, stack validation, and plan preview. Apply and recovery remain experimental. [Read the AAS Core preview guide](https://github.com/sickn33/agentic-awesome-skills/blob/v20.6.0/docs/users/aas-core.md) for setup and exact trust boundaries.

This README tracks `main`. Features listed under [Unreleased](CHANGELOG.md#unreleased) require a later release; the versioned guide describes the published package.

This is an independent community project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Google. Google, Antigravity, Gemini, and related names describe compatibility and install targets. The GitHub repository is canonical; the [hosted catalog](https://aaskills.tech/) and browser-local Workbench are companion discovery and review surfaces.
